description: Disaster situation and operation and maintenance data of Baoji power grid from 2017 to 2025 2017-2025 年宝鸡电网灾情及运维数据 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Meng Lingbo (西安交通大学电气工程学院). The data is sourced from State Grid Baoji Power Supply Company, covering samples of tripping faults caused by icing, tower static data (terrain type, altitude, insulation level, etc.), and extracting key information such as tripping time and icing thickness. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2060885 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
